verdict.rationale: The only MCP-related evidence is a pricing table line item 'MCP server | Yes' (twenty-docs-32), which indicates Twenty exposes an MCP server for others to call its own tools — not that Twenty acts as an MCP client that can plug in external MCP servers so its AI agents can use their tools. No documentation describes configuring or connecting external MCP servers within Twenty's AI agent framework (twenty-docs-5, twenty-docs-18, twenty-docs-56 describe agents but only mention internal actions like enrichment, not external MCP tool integration).
